meta.label: S&P 500 forward earnings yield less 10-year Treasury yield
meta.formula: ERP = 10000 x (forward 12m EPS / price) - 100 x 10y yield
meta.forward_eps_method: Calendar-overlap-weighted sum of bottom-up consensus quarterly operating EPS across the next 365 days.
meta.consensus_source: S&P Dow Jones Indices 'S&P 500 Earnings and Estimates' workbook, read from 69 archived point-in-time vintages (2013-06-06 to 2026-01-30); no look-ahead.
meta.treasury_source: U.S. Treasury daily par yield curve, 10-year (authoritative; Cboe ^TNX fills gaps only).

segments.b: backcast: published trailing EPS x calibrated forward multiple
segments.e: extrapolated: final vintage carried at its implied growth
